mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id as noticeId, n.title, n.content, n.publish_time as publishTime, n.publisher_id as publisherId, COALESCE(n.notice_type, '教学通知') as noticeType, COALESCE(n.publish_dept, '院办') as publishDept, COALESCE(n.attachments, '[]') as attachments, COALESCE(n.receive_roles, '') as receiveRoles, COALESCE(n.receive_depts, '') as receiveDepts, COALESCE(n.status, 'published') as status, n.publisher_type as publisherType, COALESCE(n.publisher_name, CASE WHEN n.publisher_type = 'teacher' AND t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN n.publisher_type = 'admin' AND a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username WHEN t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username ELSE '未知' END ) as publisherName FROM NOTICE n LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON n.publisher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON n.publisher_id = a.admin_id ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC

SELECT n.notice_id as noticeId, n.title, n.content, n.publish_time as publishTime, n.publisher_id as publisherId, COALESCE(n.notice_type, '教学通知') as noticeType, COALESCE(n.publish_dept, '院办') as publishDept, COALESCE(n.attachments, '[]') as attachments, COALESCE(n.receive_roles, '') as receiveRoles, COALESCE(n.receive_depts, '') as receiveDepts, COALESCE(n.status, 'published') as status, n.publisher_type as publisherType, COALESCE(n.publisher_name, CASE WHEN n.publisher_type = 'teacher' AND t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN n.publisher_type = 'admin' AND a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username WHEN t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username ELSE '未知' END ) as publisherName FROM NOTICE n LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON n.publisher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON n.publisher_id = a.admin_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId}

SELECT DISTINCT n.notice_id as noticeId, n.title, n.content, n.publish_time as publishTime, n.publisher_id as publisherId, COALESCE(n.notice_type, '教学通知') as noticeType, COALESCE(n.publish_dept, '院办') as publishDept, COALESCE(n.attachments, '[]') as attachments, COALESCE(n.receive_roles, '') as receiveRoles, COALESCE(n.receive_depts, '') as receiveDepts, COALESCE(nr.remind_count, 0) as remindCount, CASE WHEN nr.is_todo = 1 THEN 'todo' WHEN nr.is_received = 1 THEN 'read' ELSE 'unread' END as status, n.publisher_type as publisherType, COALESCE(n.publisher_name, CASE WHEN n.publisher_type = 'teacher' AND t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN n.publisher_type = 'admin' AND a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username WHEN t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username ELSE '未知' END ) as publisherName FROM NOTICE n LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON n.publisher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON n.publisher_id = a.admin_id LEFT JOIN NOTICE_RECEIVE nr ON n.notice_id = nr.notice_id AND nr.teacher_id = #{teacherId} WHERE -- 公告列表只显示"别人发给我"的通知，自己发布的去"我的发布"查看 n.notice_id IN ( SELECT nr2.notice_id FROM NOTICE_RECEIVE nr2 WHERE nr2.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TEACHER_ROLE tr WHERE tr.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND tr.role_id = 1 ) OR ( n.receive_roles IS NOT NULL AND n.receive_roles != '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NOTICE_RECEIVE nr3 WHERE nr3.notice_id = n.notice_id) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TEACHER_ROLE tr WHERE tr.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND FIND_IN_SET(tr.role_id, n.receive_roles) ) ) OR ( n.receive_depts IS NOT NULL AND n.receive_depts != '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NOTICE_RECEIVE nr4 WHERE nr4.notice_id = n.notice_id) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TEACHER_DEPT td LEFT JOIN DEPT d ON td.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE td.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND FIND_IN_SET(d.dept_name, n.receive_depts) ) ) ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC

SELECT n.notice_id as noticeId, n.title, n.content, n.publish_time as publishTime, n.publisher_id as publisherId, COALESCE(n.notice_type, '教学通知') as noticeType, COALESCE(n.publish_dept, '院办') as publishDept, COALESCE(n.attachments, '[]') as attachments, COALESCE(n.receive_roles, '') as receiveRoles, COALESCE(n.receive_depts, '') as receiveDepts, COALESCE(n.status, 'published') as status, n.publisher_type as publisherType, COALESCE(n.publisher_name, CASE WHEN n.publisher_type = 'teacher' AND t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN n.publisher_type = 'admin' AND a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username WHEN t.teacher_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.name WHEN a.admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.username ELSE '未知' END ) as publisherName FROM NOTICE n LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON n.publisher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON n.publisher_id = a.admin_id WHERE n.publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND (n.publisher_type = #{publisherType} OR n.publisher_type IS NULL) ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE (title, content, publish_time, publisher_id, publisher_type, notice_type, publish_dept, attachments, receive_roles, receive_depts, status, publisher_name) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{publishTime}, #{publisherId}, #{publisherType}, #{noticeType}, #{publishDept}, #{attachments}, #{receiveRoles}, #{receiveDepts}, #{status}, #{publisherName})
